description.narrative: Founded in 1982, GDM Argentina S.A. is a leading global seed genetics company specializing in high-productivity soybean and other crop varieties. The IFC Project will support the breeding R&D program in Argentina, helping GDM Argentina to develop new seed varieties that aim to increase yield in corn, soybean and wheat, which helps to reduce the agri carbon footprint.

IFC expects the Project to improve access to high yielding seeds for farmers, to generate positive climate adaptation effects, and to produce economy wide effects in terms of job creation and value addition. Beyond the Project, IFC expects its financing to contribute to improving the resilience of the soybean, corn and wheat farming sectors in Argentina by demonstrating innovations in seed variety development with far-reaching impact on agricultural sector resilience.
